WITH ranked_paths AS (
    SELECT session, stamp, path,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) as rn
    FROM activity_log
)
SELECT rp3.path as third_page_visit, COUNT(*) as visit_count
FROM ranked_paths rp1
JOIN ranked_paths rp2 ON rp1.session = rp2.session AND rp2.rn = rp1.rn + 1
JOIN ranked_paths rp3 ON rp2.session = rp3.session AND rp3.rn = rp2.rn + 1
WHERE rp1.path = '/detail' AND rp2.path = '/detail'
GROUP BY rp3.path
ORDER BY visit_count DESC, third_page_visit

WITH ordered_visits AS (
    SELECT 
        session,
        stamp,
        path,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) as rn
    FROM activity_log
),
sequences AS (
    SELECT 
        a.rn,
        b.rn + 1 as rn2,
        c.rn + 2 as rn3,
        a.session,
        a.path as path1,
        b.path as path2,
        c.path as path3
    FROM ordered_visits a
    JOIN ordered_visits b ON a.session = b.session AND a.rn = b.rn + 1
    JOIN ordered_visits c ON b.session = c.session AND b.rn = c.rn + 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT path3 as third_page
FROM sequences
WHERE LOWER(path1) = '/detail' AND LOWER(path2) = '/detail'
ORDER BY path3

        stamp,
        path,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) as rn

),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        session,
        stamp,
        path,
        LAG(path) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) as prev_path,
        LAG(path, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) as prev2_path
    FROM ordered_visits
)
SELECT path, COUNT(*) as third_page_count
FROM with_lag
WHERE prev_path = '/detail' AND prev2_path = '/detail'
GROUP BY path
